env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# A function with an unnamed option result and a defer? or an errdefer
# gets synthetic result names. The name must precede the lowered option
# type in the ejected text, for an ordinary function, for a copy of a
# comptime generic, and for a pointer payload.
logos eject -o $WORK/out
cd $WORK/out
grep '\(_logos_r0 _logos_rt\.Option\[int64\], _logos_err error\)' main.go
! grep 'Option\[int64_logos_r0' main.go
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/optresult

go 1.27
-- m/gen/gen.lgo --
// Package gen holds a comptime generic whose result is an option.
package gen

import "comptime"

// Closer stands for a resource with a fallible close.
type Closer struct{}

// Close never fails.
func (Closer) Close() error { return nil }

// First returns the zero value of T as a present option.
func First[T any](c Closer) (T?, error) {
	defer c.Close()?
	var out T?
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return out, nil
	}
	var v T
	out = v
	return out, nil
}
-- m/main.lgo --
// Command optresult exercises synthetic result names next to option
// results under eject.
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optresult/gen"
)

func plain(c gen.Closer) (int64?, error) {
	defer c.Close()?
	var out int64?
	out = 7
	return out, nil
}

func pointer(c gen.Closer, n *int64) (*int64?, error) {
	defer c.Close()?
	return n, nil
}

func undone(log *[]string) (int64?, error) {
	errdefer note(log)?
	return nil, errors.New("failed")
}

func note(log *[]string) error {
	*log = append(*log, "errdefer ran")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	c := gen.Closer{}
	v, err := plain(c)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(v ?? -1)
	n := int64(9)
	p, err := pointer(c, &n)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	if p != nil {
		fmt.Println(*p)
	}
	g, err := gen.First[int64](c)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(g ?? -1)
	var log []string
	_, err = undone(&log)
	fmt.Println(err, log)
}
